resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 2014 survey lists Petway among Division of Forestry towers. The Ashland City Fire Department page mentions a TWRA fire tower near its Petway Road station but does not name it, so it may be a different structure. The sources do not settle who runs this tower now.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No build date, builder, height or design in any readable source. The Forest Lookouts page has only the name and county. The Ashland station page does not name the tower and calls the nearby one a TWRA fire tower; whether that is this tower is not established, so the agency fact rests on the 2014 survey alone. The TWRA Cheatham WMA page read by fetch_text has no mention of a tower. The old county tour says the state bought the wildlife area land in the mid-1930s; no source ties that to this tower, so it is not used. Acreage conflicts between the tour page (about 22,000) and the current TWRA page (about 20,810); not used. Whether the tower sits inside the WMA is not established. Two WebSearch calls used. No photos found.
